topic: Analytics model aggregation for transit data
summary_markdown: The conversation confirms the required inputs for a new function, `isCalibrated`, which needs level signal, session duration, and operational time (though the latter is noted as outdated). Later, someone was asked to add a new model for RZK Digital Media. The request specified aggregating transit analytics data in models 4 and 5 at both 1-hour and 2-hour intervals. This aggregation was subsequently completed.
decisions: Transit analytics data in models 4 and 5 will be aggregated at 1-hour and 2-hour intervals.
